# Product names

> **这页管什么**：产品名怎么写：大小写、缩写、前面加不加 the、能不能变复数或所有格。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/product-names> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Capitalization

- Google product names are generally in title case, capitalizing every word except prepositions and articles.
- Yield to the actual UI label when referencing one.
- Follow the official capitalization set by the originating company or community.
- If an official name starts lowercase (`macOS`), keep it lowercase even at the start of a sentence — though restructuring to avoid that position is preferred.
- **Feature names** are typically lowercase unless officially capitalized or matching a UI label.

## Abbreviating

- Use the full trademarked product name. Avoid abbreviations except when mirroring a UI label, and even then keep the reference unambiguous.
- After establishing the specific product name once, you may fall back on general terminology ("a service mesh").

## Articles before product names

- Use *the* before tool and API names.
- Don't use *the* before a product name, unless the product name modifies another noun.
- Recommended: "the Transcoder API", "the gcloud CLI", "the Cloud Datastore options page".
- Not: "the Cloud Datastore".

## Possessives, plurals, verbs

- Don't form a possessive from a product, feature, or trademarked name — use it as a modifier, or restructure with *of*.
- Don't pluralize.
- **Never use a product or feature name as a verb.**

## Multiple products

Use the collective term "services", unless that creates confusion.
